summary:
嬌生EPS精準符合預期，多元醫療組合穩健如常。
• EPS 2.46美元，精準符合預期2.46美元。
• 單季營收245.6億美元，製藥與醫材組合穩定貢獻。
• 創新藥管線（腫瘤、免疫、神經）支撐長期成長。
• 醫療器材在手術量回升下穩健成長。
• 本益比27.38倍，並具防禦性與穩健股利。
ai_view:
訊號中性：EPS精準符合預期，反映嬌生一貫穩定、可預期的獲利特質。短中期股價防禦性佳，適合作為波動環境中的核心配置。市場焦點在創新藥管線能否抵銷專利懸崖，以及訴訟風險的最終定案。追蹤指標：製藥新藥營收占比、Stelara侵蝕速度、醫材成長、訴訟和解進度、研發管線里程碑。穩健股利與多元化是其長期吸引力；缺乏爆發性但下檔風險相對可控。

需留意：Stelara等專利到期帶來營收侵蝕壓力。；滑石粉訴訟的潛在賠償不確定性。；藥價監管與醫保政策影響定價空間。

summary_en:
J&J meets EPS exactly, with its diversified healthcare mix steady as usual.
• EPS of $2.46 met the $2.46 estimate precisely.
• Quarterly revenue of $24.56B with stable pharma and medtech contribution.
• Innovative pipeline (oncology, immunology, neuroscience) supports long-term growth.
• Medtech grows steadily on recovering procedure volumes.
• P/E of 27.38 with defensive traits and steady dividends.

ai_view_en:
Signal neutral: EPS met estimates exactly, reflecting J&J's consistent, predictable earnings. Near to mid-term, the stock is defensive and suits a core allocation in volatile markets. Focus is on whether the innovative pipeline can offset the patent cliff and on the resolution of litigation risk. Track: new-drug revenue mix, Stelara erosion pace, medtech growth, litigation settlement progress, and pipeline milestones. Steady dividends and diversification are its long-term appeal; little explosive upside but relatively contained downside.

Watch：Patent expiries such as Stelara create revenue-erosion pressure.; Talc litigation poses uncertain potential liabilities.; Drug-pricing regulation and insurance policy affect pricing power.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS驚喜-0.11%，幾乎完全符合，營收245.6億美元規模穩健。
